name: Pump.fun
revenue_definition: DefiLlama's covered Pump products, including launch and trading products. Retained protocol and holder revenue after supply-side allocations; not the income of every coin launched on Pump.

name: Render
revenue_definition: DefiLlama models gross BME job spend from on-chain RENDER burn value divided by 0.95. Its revenue includes the modeled off-chain service share; this is not directly observed company profit or a cash payout.

name: Pyth Network
revenue_definition: Provider aggregate across covered Pyth products and chains. Treasury revenue is not a PYTH-holder payout; product and reporting coverage can differ.

name: Meteora
revenue_definition: Provider aggregate across covered Meteora liquidity and launch products. Fee rules differ by product; this is not the return from holding MET or from one LP position.

name: Collector Crypt
revenue_definition: Provider-defined gacha sales and marketplace royalties net of pack buybacks, plus claimed LP fees. This is not net business profit or a claim on a physical collectible.

name: Kamino
revenue_definition: Kamino Lend coverage only: retained interest spreads and covered liquidation or origination fees. Excludes other Kamino products; not a KMNO-holder yield or deposit APY.

name: deBridge
revenue_definition: Provider-defined retained deBridge fees across covered chains. Transferred volume and solver or liquidity-provider funds are not protocol revenue.

name: Helium
revenue_definition: Provider-defined Helium network usage revenue. Data-credit use, HNT burns and token issuance are separate flows; this is not a passive HNT-holder payout.

name: ORE
revenue_definition: Provider-defined ORE Protocol fees and revenue. This does not model mining costs, participant profits or the return from holding ORE.

name: Huma Finance
revenue_definition: Huma 2.0 permissionless-pool coverage only. The adapter reports no configured protocol fee; reported Fees are LP yield accruals, not HUMA-holder income or all Huma business revenue.

name: Sanctum
revenue_definition: Provider aggregate across covered Sanctum reserve, liquidity and validator-LST products. SANC is separate from those LST receipts; this is not the yield from holding SANC.

name: Not in Employment, Education, or Training
Metaplex
revenue_definition: Fees retained by the covered Metaplex programs. The value and trading volume of independently issued NFTs and tokens are not Metaplex revenue.

name: Marinade
revenue_definition: Marinade Native coverage only; excludes other Marinade products. Protocol-retained amounts are separate from SOL staker rewards and do not imply an MNDE-holder payout.

name: HumidiFi
revenue_definition: DefiLlama estimates HumidiFi trading PnL from net inventory changes. Values may be negative and exclude unobserved offchain hedges or funding costs; this is not audited net revenue or WET-holder income.
